Recruitment lists — Data Scores + Bristol Fit %

Bristol Fit = style + what Bristol need. LOW MINS = Champ / League One / Scottish Prem with <500′ this season. Season chips filter on 26/27 · 25/26 · 24/25 Data Scores. Tab 500+ mins by league = Supabase last 3 seasons.

Away form briefing · L2 26/27 to 3 Oct · Home 4-0-0 · Away 1-0-4

It is not effort — we press more away. Gaps are box access, defending our third under direct play, press reward (then H2 fade), and own-third mistakes. Use Bristol Fit lists to fill those roles, not just “good players”.

1 · Can’t reach their box41 → 25 box touches/g · passes into box 16 → 8. Same long volume, worse contests (40% → 34%). Cavegn xG/90 0.73 → 0.09; wide supply dries (e.g. James xG chain/90 0.90 → 0.44).
2 · They live in our thirdOpp passes into our FT 59 → 74. Clearances 21 → 29; their chances nearly 2× quality. Defend deeper, dribbled past ~doubles.
3 · Press more, win less, fadePressures 121 → 135 but force fewer errors (23.5% → 19.7%). 7 of 11 away goals after HT (6 after 60’). Played through when chasing.
4 · Mistakes under pressure7/11 away goals after losing it in our third. High-press games (Grimsby / Gillingham / Crewe) punish decisions. Named in chain: Harbottle (2), Mola, Forde, Sparkes, Kilgour, Young.

Recruitment implication: CB who win first balls + stay secure when pressed · midfielder who screens/clears under direct play · wide / 8 who carry box supply away · GK with away shot-stopping when over-conceding vs xG. Prefer profiles that cover Deep Completions Conceded, Pressures F2 / high-press shots, OP shots / box touches, and transition shots on the Fit notes.

Flags / filters: LOW MINS = Champ / L1 / Scottish Prem <500′ this season. Season chips filter who has a Data Score in 26/27 · 25/26 · 24/25 (or all three). Tab 500+ mins by league = Supabase minutes for those same three seasons.

Top-5 fantasy points · role vs need (what they are not doing away)

Fantasy leaderboard (pts → mins → pts/90). Home/away from StatsBomb player match stats (available L2 games). Gap = role duty vs the four away needs above.

#PlayerFantasyRoleAway evidenceNot doing vs needHire / list focus
1Harbottle 15 pts · 519′ · 2.60/90 CB — first contact, stop direct play, secure under press Pressures/90 10.1→8.3 · tackles/90 3.3→1.3 · OBV def/90 0.09→0.05 · named 2× own-third error chain Not winning enough defensive actions away; not the secure out-ball when opponents press into our third CB list: press + deep-block Fit; composure under press
2Balmer 11 pts · 830′ · 1.19/90 CB — recoveries, organise deeper block, progressive value OBV/90 0.37→0.19 · recoveries/90 15.2→12.4 · more minutes away than home Less ball-winning / progressive value when they live in our third — volume of mins not matching away output CB who sustain recoveries + aerial/first balls away
3Kilgour 9 pts · 145′ · 5.59/90 CB — physical presence, duel wins, error-free when pressed ~47′ away / ~97′ home only · OBV negative both venues · named in own-third error chain Not yet a reliable away stabiliser (tiny sample + mistake mention) — fantasy pts/90 inflated by low mins Do not treat as proven away CB; still need a secure starter profile
4Forde 8 pts · 692′ · 1.04/90 Wide / attacker — box supply, retain under press, chance chain Pressures/90 13.0→20.4 but dispos/90 2.1→2.5 · named in error chain · team box access halves away Chasing hard without end product or security — effort up, ball lost in dangerous areas; not fixing “can’t reach their box” Winger / 8 / CF-B: OP shots, box touches, transition — retainers not just pressers
4Young 8 pts · 887′ · 0.81/90 GK — deny when chances break through (esp. H2 away) Save% ~75% home → ~35% away · 19 npOT faced away vs 11 home · GSAA −1.71 away · worst away save% vs L2 GKs Not preventing goals away once the press is played through / structure breaks — shot-stopping gap vs need GK upgrade or cover with strong away GSAA / save% vs npxG

Sources: Why we lose away from home.pdf · Bristol H/A + half report · conceded / GK league away table · fantasy pts image (club). Pattern to keep: results follow box access (Crawley A = home-level access = win).
